title: A Cipher for the Deadline Revisited
author: Freya Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Nakamura, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
